outgoing.name: Ancient Rome
outgoing.excerpt: The Romans used beetroot as a treatment for fevers and constipation, amongst other ailments.

outgoing.name: Boron
outgoing.excerpt: It is a rich source of the mineral boron, which plays an important role in the production of human sex hormones.

outgoing.name: Flower
outgoing.excerpt: The flowers are produced in dense spikes, each flower very small, 3-5 mm diameter, green or tinged reddish, with five petals; they are wind-pollinated.

outgoing.name: Hippocrates
outgoing.excerpt: Hippocrates advocated the use of beet leaves as binding for wounds.

outgoing.name: Middle Ages
outgoing.excerpt: From the Middle Ages, beetroot was used as a treatment for a variety of conditions, especially illnesses relating to digestion and the blood.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: In the United States, it is the traditional colorant for pink lemonade.
